summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting proposals to sunset or eliminate it, and emphasizes the importance of E-Rate for providing reliable broadband access to students and libraries.

claims.requested_action: view E-Rate success as a reason to preserve and improve the program
claims.argument: E-Rate has enabled schools to provide reliable educational access
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate has enabled schools (public and private) and libraries to build and maintain the connectivity necessary for students and patrons to participate fully in modern education

claims.argument: Removing E-Rate funding would increase the gap between students with and without access to resources
claims.evidence_quote: Removing this critical funding source would only work to increase the gap between those with a means to provide these resources and those without.
